Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

There was a Hindu person and a Catholic person talking about the different things they do during religious ceremonies. The Catholic one described a lot of reading from books and gathering as a community, while the Hindu one said that religious ceremonies tend to be organized around some image of a deity that everyone prays to. Who does not worship idols?
A. Not enough information
B. The Hindu one
C. The Catholic one
